guard_streams.source: May 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
guard_streams.write_limit: The May 2025 OMR release is a historical BDUK planning snapshot and does not establish current selected-parcel availability.

facts.detail: The May 2025 OMR publication was published on 12 September 2025.
The publication applies to England and Wales.
It includes an HTML UPRN-level guide and technical note.
It provides a 173 KB sample CSV.
The release provides regional ZIPs and a no-geographical-region CSV.
The West Midlands ZIP is listed as 37.9 MB.
The Yorkshire and the Humber ZIP is listed as 37.9 MB.
The North West ZIP is listed as 49 MB.
The South East ZIP is listed as 58.9 MB.
The release describes current connectivity, future plans and BDUK interventions, not comprehensive historic delivery.

facts.detail: The January 2025 OMR publication was published on 1 July 2025.
The publication applies to England and Wales.
It includes an HTML user guide and technical note.
It provides a 173 KB sample CSV.
The North East regional ZIP is listed as 14.7 MB.
The North West regional ZIP is listed as 41 MB.
The London regional ZIP is listed as 45.1 MB.
The South East regional ZIP is listed as 50.7 MB.

guard_streams.source: January 2025 OMR user guide and technical note
guard_streams.write_limit: The guide documents historical OMR timing, supplier-response gaps and changing contracts; its flags are not exact present-day parcel service evidence.

facts.detail: The January 2025 technical note was published on 1 July 2025.
BDUK replaced separate postcode/UPRN outputs and maps with a single transparency release.
Supplier and contract fields were separated for each intervention product.
CSV files were split by local authority district and zipped by region.
Some supplier names were standardised.
Regional fields used NSUL April 2025 and NSPL February 2025 data.
The release is designed for programming software and may not fully display in Excel.
BDUK planned releases about once every four months.
The premises base uses AddressBase Premium and removes non-postal and demolished premises.
The guide warns that post-January connections and suppliers not responding to OMR can create gaps and differences from Ofcom.
